title: Pandowdy Pancake with Apple Compote
description: A Norwegian-inspired dessert featuring a crumbly pancake topped with a warm apple compote.

ingredients.name: Apples
ingredients.notes: any variety works well, but sweeter apples like Gala or Fuji are preferred

ingredients.name: Flaky butter
ingredients.notes: to enhance the pancake's texture and flavor

ingredients.name: Yellowed sugar
ingredients.notes: use to balance the sweetness and add a hint of caramel

instructions: In a separate pan, melt the flaky butter over medium heat. Add the sliced apples and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add 1 tablespoon of yellowed sugar to the pan and continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the apples are cooking, prepare the pancake according to the package instructions. Flip the pancake and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the pancake to a plate and top with the warm apple compote. Serve immediately.
To make the compote, combine the cooked apples, melted butter, and remaining 1 tablespoon of yellowed sugar in a bowl. Mix well and adjust the sweetness to taste.
